source: I want clicker game and I want a chill park map that I can walk around In with my roblox character. I want there to be a rebirth buttons that doubles clicks. An admin panel only i have and i can give any amount of clicks up to infinity and can start a 2x event and can talk to every globally in game. I want there to be an egg with pets a uncommon pig pet with a 60% chance to get, a rare cat with a 25% chance to get, an epic dog with a 10% chance to get, a legendary horse with a 1% chance, a mythic shark with a 0.1% chance, and a secret turtle with a 0.01% chance to get. I want no labels or texts on my screen or on the ground too

answers.ask: Should the park read as bright and cartoony, or a naturalistic modern city park?
answers.answer: Make it a bright, cartoony chill park that fits a Roblox clicker game.

answers.ask: Is the rebirth button a physical thing you walk up to in the park, or a screen button?
answers.answer: Make the rebirth button a physical button players walk up to in the park, with no text labels.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D game map as a bright, cartoony chill park that a Roblox character can freely walk around. Arrange open grassy paths and simple park scenery around a central physical rebirth button that players can walk up to; the button has no text label. Include a pet egg as a visible park prop or interaction point, also without ground text, signs, or on-screen labels.
blob:
### 1. Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation: this is a clicker/incremental game with rebirth progression, while the park is its walkable setting.

### 2. Shape and preset
Use `world-open`, taken from the Simulation Incremental Simulator preset: one contiguous, freely walkable park rather than isolated plots or a tiered progression route. The preset’s shop hub, purchase gates, and dedicated circulation chain are not requested and are omitted.

### 3. Config requirements
No image-config options are required beyond the described park geometry. Do not add shops, gates, NPCs, water, terrain relief, signs, ground text, UI labels, or decorative text. The central rebirth control and pet egg are scene props, not labelled interfaces.

### 4. Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-rebirth` at the central physical rebirth button, reachable directly from all surrounding paths. Its interaction is represented by the button’s placement only; it must carry no visible text, icon, or ground label.

### 5. Layout components
Build a small open park on one level. The central zone is a circular grassy clearing containing one oversized, friendly cartoony physical rebirth button, visually distinct through shape and color but completely unlabelled. Place one pet egg interaction prop slightly off-center beside the clearing, also without text, signs, or ground markings. Several broad, gently curving grassy paths radiate from and loop around the clearing, creating relaxed free-roam circulation rather than a directed course. Add sparse simple park scenery—rounded trees, bushes, flowers, benches, and low decorative rocks—kept clear of the main walking routes. Use a soft tree-and-bush perimeter as the natural map edge without walls or urban structures. Compose the clearing as the visual center, with the button immediately legible and the egg visible nearby in the isometric frame.

### 6. Render order
Use `isometric`: the simple, open single-surface park does not need topology validation before its cartoony visual composition is drawn.

### 7. Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is small, driven by one central interaction clearing and a compact free-roam park. Theme: bright, cartoony, calm Roblox clicker park with clean readable shapes and no written labels. Pipeline modifier: `P0`, because the map is one open, single-level surface with no forced additional capture path.
